newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's top reinsurance firm sees profit surge.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's top reinsurance firm sees profit surge.

text.p: The head of Colombia's top reinsurance company, Reaseguradora de Colombia SA, said he sees the firm increasing its net profit substantially, from 29.5 billion pesos in 1996 to 45 billion in 1997.

Santiago Vasquez, Reaseguradora's president, said in a Reuter interview that his upbeat assessment was partly based on a decision to diversify the firm's investment portfolio, with likely forays into energy, biotechnology and other sectors. Vasquez also said he sees the yield from Reaseguradora's premiums increasing to $85 million this year from $65 million in 1996.

Reaseguradora, which is partly owned by the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, had a 350.5 billion peso investment portfolio last year. Its current investments include stakes in Promigas, the main natural gas distributor on Colombia's Caribbean coast, as well as in Banco de Bogota and in leading retailers Almacenes Exito and Carulla.
Vasquez said it is also invested in Venezuela, Chile, Ecuador and Peru, and to a lesser extent, in the United States, Germany and Spain.
